CustomField.description: Materialized ancestor path, maintained by ResourceCategoryTreeHandler — never edit by hand. "/" for a top-level category, "/<rootId>/<parentId>/" for a grandchild. Descendants of a category X are the rows whose Path__c starts with X.Path__c + X.Id + "/". Recomputed on every save; scripts/apex/backfillCategoryPaths.apex repairs it in bulk.
CustomField.label: Path
